# Critical Risk Management+

The first CRM to truly change history

## The world’s leading CRM+ so much more

All industry fatalities are preventable.

How can we make such a claim? Consider our track record; a global mining giant records zero fatalities for the first time in 147 years. Another recently celebrated 10 million fatality-free shifts. Other early adopters reach 8 years without an on-site death. All after full implementation of Forwood CRM+.

[Download CRM+ BrochureDownload CRM+ Brochure](https://forwoodsafety.com/solutions/critical-risk-management/#form)

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/Frame-18-3-1.png)

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/shutterstock_1089455279-scaled.jpg)

Today, globally, over 800 customer sites successfully use Forwood’s CRM+.

The industry doesn’t matter. Your country, language or culture makes no difference. You won’t need to replace your software or processes. CRM+ is simple yet comprehensive, forward thinking and successful.

## How does it work?

CRM+ is a layered verification process focused on fatality elimination. The solution enables:

- The identification and understanding of critical risks that can lead to fatalities and serious injuries.
- The implementation of a manageable set of critical controls.
- The evaluation of critical control effectiveness every day.

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/Geolocation-3.jpg)

### Critical Risks Identified

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/quicksight-edit-with-numbers.png)

To do this, CRM+ generates a significant volume of _leading indicator_ data that enables key insights to be gained and, in particular, assist in identifying areas of risk before an incident occurs. Plus, you’ll move from reactive to proactive risk management due to CRM+’s advanced data analytics.

## New to CRM? Download Our Guide

Critical Risk Management (CRM) is a proven safety method for preventing fatalities in high-risk industries. World leaders in the advancement of the CRM methodology, Forwood have developed **five pillars of best practice** through years of in-field experience. Adhering to these best practices is crucial for a robust and compliant CRM system. Download the booklet for a comprehensive overview of the Critical Risk Management methodology, its five pillars of best practice, and how Forwood’s CRM+ solution can help steamline the process.

[Download CRM Guide](https://forwoodsafety.com/resources/guides-reports/five-pillars-of-best-practice-critical-risk-management/)

![](https://forwoodsafety.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/booklet-five-pillars-of-crm-1.png)

## The key features that make CRM+, a world-leading risk management tool

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20160%20160%27%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20fill-opacity%3D%220%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)

### Laser Focus

CRM+ is designed and built to provide a laser focus on fatality prevention, protecting front line workers from serious harm by changing the culture of risk management throughout your business.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20160%20160%27%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20fill-opacity%3D%220%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)

### Simplicity

Easy to use app, with corresponding pictograms, enable everyone to participate in fatality prevention.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20160%20160%27%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20fill-opacity%3D%220%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)

### Tiered Methodology

CRM+’s 3-tiered verification methodology establishes a triple cross-check on all Critical Risks and Controls, providing a unique opportunity to identify, recognize, manage, and ultimately block fatal risks.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20160%20160%27%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20fill-opacity%3D%220%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)

### Online & Offline

Online and offline native app, for Apple and Android, works equally as well where connectivity is limited or unavailable.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20160%20160%27%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20fill-opacity%3D%220%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)

### Geo Maps

All verification data can be geo-located, on the surface and underground, to enable data to be viewed by site.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20160%20160%27%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20fill-opacity%3D%220%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)

### Content

CRM+’s Critical Control Checklists are industry best practice, refined over many years in the field.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20160%20160%27%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20fill-opacity%3D%220%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)

### End-to-end Solution

A full end-to-end Risk Management Process with a Patent Protected Critical Control Verification System.

![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%20160%20160%27%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%27160%27%20height%3D%27160%27%20fill-opacity%3D%220%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E)

CRM+ seamlessly integrates with all major EHS & risk management solutions.
